data.narrative:
Nano Nuclear Energy is a seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Jay Jiang Yu, currently valued at $808M post-money following $600M+ in total funding. The nuclear energy sector comprises 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method here. Applying a standard 2.5x seed-to-next-stage multiplier to the $808M last post-money valuation implies a forward valuation of $2.0B. This multiplier reflects typical step-up dynamics for capital-intensive frontier technology companies advancing from seed to Series A. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible; while 5 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filter (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier) yielded fewer than 3 datapoints, making a median-based approach unreliable and risking false precision.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.7B to $2.3B, centered on $2.0B, derived from stage-progression mechanics alone. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiplier for a capital-raise-intensive frontier technology (2.5x may not reflect nuclear-specific dilution patterns) and the limited depth of nuclear energy comparables at the seed stage. Given the single-method foundation, users should weight this range as a floor estimate pending accumulation of additional peers or completion of the next funding event.
